blocks.x: Now ladies and gentlemen, Tape Five, this is the end of Side One. We will be right back with Side Two of the interview with Baby Lovett by ART Smith and CROOK Goodwin. WE'll be right back.

Good evening once again ladies and gentlemen. Here at the Afterhours, this is Side Two of Tape Five, the last tape and the last side of the interview with Samuel Baby Lovett, the great Baby Lovett, being interviewed by Art Smith and Charles Crook Goodwin, and we learned just recently on the other side of this tape that Baby was introduced at Carnegie Hall in New York last year. You never know what you're going to run into when you start interviewing these personages.
